1.consolidated_definition: Pieza de metal, cuyos dos extremos, doblados y aguzados, se clavan para sujetar dos o más cosas, especialmente hojas de papel.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Metal piece with its two ends, bent and sharpened, used to pierce and hold together two or more objects, especially sheets of paper.
